Name: Have More Kids and Adopt Leo
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
Using the [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36459]Have More Kids[/url][/i] framework by mushymato, this mod allows you to adopt Leo and have him join your household as a child, instead of as a spouse or roommate. It adds two unique events and over 150 lines of post-adoption dialogue.

Thank you to MurrtheCat's generosity in allowing the use of their dialogue, making this mod a spiritual successor to their original [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13861]Adopt Leo[/url][/i] mod!

[b][color=#dd7e6b][size=6]H[/size][size=5]ow to Adopt Leo[/size][/color][/b]
[spoiler]You need to have seen Leo's vanilla 9-heart event, have him at max hearts, and have your Farmhouse at level 2. You'll then see an event in Town when it's sunny between 9 AM and 5 PM, on days other than Sunday and Monday. Afterwards, you'll be able to adopt Leo from the registry book on the clinic's counter table.[/spoiler]
[b][color=#ffe599][size=6]S[/size][/color][size=5][color=#ffe599]pecial Mod Interactions[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url][/i]: If you have it installed, Leo's post-adoption dialogue will integrate CFDE content.[/*]
[*][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9242]Ginger Island NPC Overhaul[/url][/i]: If you have it installed, Leo will have some additional dialogues.[/*]
[/list][color=#b6d7a8][b]﻿[size=6]I[/size][size=5]nstallation[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][i]Content Patcher[/i][/url]﻿ and [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36459]Have More Kids[/url][/i] installed.[/*]
[*]Download [b][i]Have More Kids and Adopt Leo[/i][/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded file into the game's [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Have More Kids and Adopt Leo[/font] from your Mods folder.

[color=#a2c4c9][b][size=6]C[/size][size=5]ompatibility[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]May conflict with any mod that changes Leo's dialogue and schedule.[/*]
[*]Should be compatible with and retain schedules in [b][i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i][/b], [b][i]Community Center Reimagined[/i][/b], and [b][i]Little Red School House[/i][/b].[/*]
[*]Please also look at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36459][i]Have More Kids[/i][/url]'s page and comment section for system compatibility concerns.[/*]
[*]No other known compatibility issues. Please report if you find any![/*]
[/list][color=#9fc5e8][b][size=6]T[/size][size=5]ranslations[/size][/b][/color]
This mod uses i18n. If you want to make a translation for it, feel free to either give it to me (so I could incorporate it into the mod) or upload them yourself (do tell me so I can link to them!).
